leads.title: Belasting & Douane Museum, Rotterdam — full re-fit going to European tender
leads.note: Marktconsultatie published 18 Aug for the herinrichting of the whole museum; a European tender follows. CPV 92520000-2. Douanedek wing already closed 6 Jul 2026, so the re-fit is real and moving. Collection + a genuinely good story (smuggling, customs, tax); Rotterdam ~1hr. Dutch-language process, and the eventual tender needs a partner — but the consultation is yours to enter alone and puts your name in the file before the brief is locked. Top pick this run (8/10).
